words: Nick 2026-10-15, watching B-6c2c: 'It looks like Codex is going with an approach of something that results in the foot tapering off more. And that's not really what I want. The shape that was there was the right shape. It was just thick and swollen... rather than making the whole foot less tall.' B-6c2c stopped; method corrected to an even reduction in height of the generated paw, no taper.
